script_line: Sixty days, and you keep the straps.

risks.risk: she steadies herself on the door or the wall
risks.prevented_by: hands free; no hand on the door frame, no hand on the wall

risks.risk: the strap slides as she lands
risks.prevented_by: worn-constancy line; no strap sliding down the leg

risks.risk: the camera walks back with her
risks.prevented_by: RIG-R1C: the phone stays on the path, sways but never travels
